feedback: Repair the applicability logic so a Category A/B ship constructed on or after 2017-01-01 cannot bypass the requirement merely because it also has Category C: the non-applicable alternative must establish that the ship is not in A or B, rather than relying on a positive Category C branch. Also do not encode the derived residualStabilityFactorSI result as exact decimal equality at 1.0; use an inclusive tolerance scaled from the expected value 1.0. Preserve the declared loading-condition owner/path and both outcome alternatives.

Preserve the prior applicability repair: the graph still allows Category A or B ships constructed after 2017-01-01 to bypass the requirement. The applicable branch tests only Category A, omitting Category B, and the non-applicable branch incorrectly treats only dates in January 2017 plus years after 2017 as applicable, so February–December 2017 can pass. Encode applicability as (shipCategory A or B) AND constructionDate >= xsd:date("2017-01-01"), with the complementary branch requiring category not A/B or constructionDate before that date; do not rely on the current YEAR/MONTH/DAY logic. The per-loading-condition alternatives and inclusive derived-value tolerance are otherwise aligned.

Repair the non-applicable applicability branch while preserving the prior date repair: it must require the complementary condition that the ship category is not A or B, or that constructionDate is before 2017-01-01. Do not use a positive Category C branch, because a ship carrying both Category A or B and Category C can otherwise bypass the requirement. Retain the applicable branch as (Category A or B) AND constructionDate >= 2017-01-01, preserve the loading-condition owner/path and both outcome alternatives, and retain the inclusive tolerance scaled from the expected residual factor 1.0 rather than exact equality.

Preserve the prior applicability complement and inclusive tolerance repair. In the per-loading-condition outcome alternatives, make the residualStabilityFactorSI tolerance branch conditional on alternativeInstrumentApplicable being false (or otherwise not applicable); currently a case with alternativeInstrumentApplicable=true can pass through the residual-factor branch without alternativeInstrumentResidualStabilityStatus=true. Retain the alternative branch requiring applicability=true and compliant status. Also correct the unit IRI: use http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS (not qudt:UNITLESS under the http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/ namespace).
